question: Does pressure order distinguish transient shock from persistent deterioration, under unchanged exits?

mechanisms.base: Existing daily pressure episode control with equity targets
mechanisms.cross: Enter only when crossing from positive to nonpositive pressure
mechanisms.recover: Enter at nonpositive pressure only if better than previous day
mechanisms.deteriorate: Reverse control: nonpositive pressure worse than previous day

controls: No range filter, model forecast or date gates. Initial four natural-sign comparisons, no threshold search.
decision: Consider followup only with a clear full-account risk/return or boundary improvement; frequency or insufficient-return failures retained, no new gates.
